performance.verdict: Zero tracked leads across 28 days — attribution is broken, not just slow.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 0 tracked leads across 28 days despite $1,450.96 spend and 14 Google Ads conversions — attribution pipeline is broken.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31; no completion event recorded — CRM readiness for scale-back-up is unconfirmed and blocks intake.
Intake ownership unresolved since Vivian left 7/7: GHL shows 74 contacts and 40 opportunities but 0 appointments — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an empty seat.
Google spend is erratic: 9 zero-spend days in 28 days, daily range $0–$248.50 — pacing instability suggests campaign-level budget caps or manual pausing without a clear pattern.
GBP actions rose 23.53% week-over-week (107 total, 38 calls) while paid leads read zero — organic is generating intent that the intake system is not capturing.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL lead-source mapping: trace the 14 Google Ads conversions to GHL contacts; identify where 0 leads are recorded despite confirmed conversions.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 14 conversions in 28 days but GHL tracked 0 leads — the connector or webhook mapping is broken or misattributed. Pull the 14 conversion timestamps from Google Ads and match against the 74 GHL contacts by date to find the gap. Success is confirmed when new conversions appear in GHL within 24 hours of firing. Complete audit by 2026-08-23.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns intake post-Vivian and verify their GHL login and after-hours coverage before any budget is raised.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the booking bot battle-test due 7/31 has no completion record — speed-to-lead automations may be routing to an empty seat, which explains 0 appointments despite 40 opportunities created. Confirm the new intake owner with Nader or Xavier, verify their GHL login is active, and complete the bot battle-test. Success: named owner confirmed in writing and bot test logged as complete by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget increases; watch Google spend stability and GHL appointment count through 2026-08-23 before scaling.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend ranged $0–$248.50 with 9 zero-spend days in 28 days, and the SOW scale-back-up gate explicitly requires intake ownership to be resolved first. Do not raise daily budgets (currently averaging $30.85/day) until attribution is confirmed working and an intake owner is named. Re-check on 2026-08-23: if GHL appointments are still at 0 and lead tracking is still broken, escalate to Nacer.
